MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.2, Special Branch Station
REPORT
Date Jan 21, 1934

Enquiry from British Consulate-General re: A. C. Bekker.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev Forwarded by O. J. Sweeney

With reference to the attached letter dated December 19,
1933, from H.B.M. Consulate-General on the subject of A. Bekker,
this individual's history and record as known to this office are
as follows :-

Alexander Carlovitch (A.Ch) Bekker, Russian of Jewish
extraction, born October 22, 1894, at Petrograd. He first
arrived in Shanghai from Harbin in 1923. On June 29, 1925 he
obtained from the former Office of the Special Commissioner for
Foreign Affairs for Kiangsu, passport No.587, valid for six
months, to enable him to proceed to South Africa via Hongkong,
Singapore and Durban. He left Shanghai for the South some time
later during the same year and was not heard of until April 8,
1932, when he called at the Russian Emigrants Committee, No.6-A
Hongkong Road, for registration. On that occasion he stated
that he had returned to Shanghai from Geneva, Switzerland, on
April 4, 1932. He gave his profession as that of a journalist
and stated that he intended to proceed to Portugal in November
of the same year. An attachment to his passport No.587 reads
as follows :-

"Passport seen at the Chinese Legation, Copenhagen,
Valid for passage to Shanghai on board the s.s.
Denmark leaving Copenhagen on August 27, 1930. A
new permit shall be obtained from the local
authorities on arrival at Shanghai. August 20,
1930. Gratis."

Bekker also produced a League of Nations passport issued
in Switzerland, and two certificates of registration with the
Russian Emigrants Committees in Paris and Nice respectively.
The numbers and the dates of issue of these documents are not
available. It is reported that during the course of conversation
with various persons Bekker made references to his extensive

英国总领事馆关于 A. C. Bekker 的查询。

由特别调查员普罗科菲耶夫（Prokofiev）制作，经 O. J. Sweeney 转呈

参照随附的1933年12月19日英王陛下驻沪总领事馆关于 A. Bekker 的来信，本局所知的该人履历及记录如下：-

亚历山大·卡尔洛维奇（A.Ch）·贝克尔（Bekker），俄籍犹太人，1894年10月22日出生于彼得格勒。他于1923年首次从哈尔滨抵达上海。1925年6月29日，他从前江苏省交涉公署获得第587号护照，有效期六个月，以便经由香港、新加坡和德班前往南非。同年稍后时候，他离开上海南下，此后直到1932年4月8日才再有消息，当时他前往香港路6-A号俄国侨民委员会进行登记。在那次登记中，他声称自己于1932年4月4日从瑞士日内瓦返回上海。他申报的职业为记者，并表示打算于同年11月前往葡萄牙。其第587号护照的附件内容如下：-

“护照已于哥本哈根中国公使馆查验，
有效用于乘坐1930年8月27日离开哥本哈根的
‘丹麦’号轮船前往上海。抵达上海后须向当地
当局申请新许可证。1930年8月20日。免费。”

贝克尔还出示了一份在瑞士签发的国际联盟护照，以及分别在巴黎和尼斯的俄国侨民委员会的两份登记证书。这些文件的编号和签发日期无法提供。据报，贝克尔在与各人士交谈过程中曾提及他在欧洲和亚洲的广泛旅行经历。

（左侧页边批注：x 另见 D.19。）

travels both in Europe and Asia. According to him he resided in Palestine for about one year and was obliged to leave that country at the request of the local authorities.

On October 24, 1932, Bekker obtained from the Russian Emigrant Committee a letter to the Shanghai Bureau of Public Safety containing a request to register him as a Russian emigrant and to grant him a passport free of charge. On 6-12-32 he registered with the Bureau (Registration No.19200) and on the same date was granted passport No.1611 to enable him to proceed to Switzerland.

According to officers of the Passport Section of the Public Safety Bureau, a search of records failed to disclose any reference to foreign passport No.5407 issued by the Bureau to Bekker on April 5, 1932 or on some other date.

Bekker left Shanghai for an unknown destination some time during the later part of 1933.

Enquiries show that during the period of his second sojourn in this city he was in very reduced circumstances. On December 4, 1932, he registered with the Associated Charities of Shanghai to which body he applied for help. In the spring of 1933 he obtained an employment with the Canidrome, but was soon dismissed owing, it is reported, to his work having been found unsatisfactory. It is also reported that, as a matter of charity, he was given a chance by a local foreign firm to work as a salesman on a commission basis and that he failed to pay for the goods he had received from the firm.

For some time prior to his departure from Shanghai Bekker lived at Restaurant "Bosfor" (Bosphorus), No. 518 Avenue Joffre, a place known to be used as a rendezvous by various shady

据他称，他在巴勒斯坦居住了约一年，并应当地当局的要求被迫离开该国。

1932年10月24日，贝克尔从俄国侨民委员会获得一封致上海公安局的信函，请求将其登记为俄国侨民并免费向其签发护照。1932年12月6日，他在该局进行了登记（登记号19200），并于同日获发第1611号护照，以便前往瑞士。

据公安局护照科官员称，经查核记录，未发现该局曾于1932年4月5日或其他日期向贝克尔签发第5407号外国护照的任何记载。

贝克尔于1933年下半年某时离开上海前往未知目的地。

调查显示，在他第二次逗留本市期间，他的境况非常窘迫。1932年12月4日，他在上海慈善联合会登记，并向该机构申请援助。1933年春，他在跑狗场（Canidrome）找到一份工作，但据报道因工作表现不佳很快被解雇。另有报道称，出于慈善目的，一家本地外商公司曾给他一个按佣金制担任推销员的机会，但他未能支付从该公司收到的货物款项。

在离开上海前的一段时间里，贝克尔居住在霞飞路518号“博斯福尔”（Bosphorus，即博斯普鲁斯）餐厅，众所周知，该处是各类可疑人物的聚会地点。

by the name of A. BEKKER. This man holds a passport

fact granted, but that it was placed, not on passport No.
19200 as alleged by India, but on Shanghai Bureau of Public
Safety passport No. 1611, granted on the same date.
Further according to India on the attachment passport No.
19200 ( or what is probably more correct Shanghai passport
No. 1611) there is a British visa for travel to Bangkok
through Hongkong in transit, which was granted by the
British Consulate General at Shanghai, on the 6th April '32.

visa for this journey was in point of fact granted to

亲爱的吉文斯（Givens）：

上月，一名名为 A. BEKKER 的前俄国人乘坐机动船“喜马拉雅”号从新加坡抵达孟买。此人持有一张由上海公安局签发的护照，据印度方面称，该护照号码为19200，系该局于1932年12月6日签发。印度方面还告知我，该护照第9页包含一张经香港前往广州的英国过境签证，该签证于今年1月25日在上海签发。我查阅了我方记录，发现确实签发了此类签证，但并非如印度方面所称签在第19200号护照上，而是签在同期签发的上海公安局第1611号护照上。此外，据印度方面称，在附件护照第19200号（或更准确地说可能是上海护照第1611号）上，有一张经香港前往曼谷的英国签证，该签证由英国驻沪总领事馆于1932年4月6日签发。

贝克尔签发了此次行程的签证，但是签在1932年4月5日签发的公安局第5407号护照上。
贝克尔抵达印度时，没有进入该国的英国签证，尽管他的行为并无特别可疑之处，但我急于查明上海公安局 locally 向他签发的任何护照的正确号码。
你能否提供帮助？
贝克尔声称他曾是俄文民主派报纸《Roul》的记者。该报在柏林出版，贝克尔称他是受该报派遣前往满洲，报道那里的中日局势。
上海方面是否了解贝克尔的情况？
如蒙提供任何信息，我将不胜感激。

此致
敬礼，
H. W. Heptinstall
